verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's escalation policies are documented to notify targets sequentially until acknowledged, tied to schedules and fallback responders (docs-7, docs-37, docs-12, docs-13, docs-49), and community hands-on report confirms real-world behavior (app then phone call escalation) (pagerduty-comm-1). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of configurable delay timers and multi-round repeat escalation cycles beyond the single-target wording.
